name: MiG-29 Fulcrum: cockpit and systems
author: IornMan1213
description: The MiG-29 Fulcrum mod's plugin: the cockpit's working instruments, the SPO-15 radar warning, drop tanks, the Cobra key, folding mirrors (they reflect with NO Mirrors), Cockpit Editor setups, bullet holes and an install check. It comes with the MiG-29 Fulcrum .nobp in the same download.
